fusions.name: Butting Heel
fusions.desc: A drive with the trowel's heel that deals 13 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Coping Stone Kick
fusions.desc: Kicks a loose coping stone down at the target that deals 28 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Plant Your Feet
fusions.desc: You become immune to blows and conditions for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Won't Be Budged
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that absorbs 7% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
